thread:
Sana (People Ops): Quick ask 7 need a 1-line manager play that teams can paste into 1:1s. Must fit in a calendar note and cover goal, metric, blockers, and one sentence feedback.
Priya K: love it. keep it tiny so managers actually use it.
Ezra M: include a single "impact" prompt so ICs link work -> outcome.
Ben R: here's a 6-line pack I use in 15m check-ins:
Goal: one-liner + metric
Impact: one sentence (who benefits / why)
This sprint: 2 commits (owner + ETA)
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers/deps (owner + ETA)
Coverage plan: who covers if PTO/leave (owner + dates)
Manager ask: decision / unblock / mentoring
Mei L: add a 1-line calibration blurb managers can paste into private docs: Outcome / Signals / Suggested note.
Sana (People Ops): ok combining those into a single paste below. please react with :+1: if good or suggest edits.
Sana (People Ops): ```
MANAGER ONE-LINER (paste to calendar)
Goal: "Ship X to improve Y by Z% (metric)"
Impact: 1-line who/why
Sprint commits: 2 actions (owner + ETA)
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers & deps (owner + ETA)
Coverage: owner + dates (if PTO/leave)
Manager ask: specific support needed
Calibration: Outcome / Signals / Suggested note (private)
Feedback script: "When you did X I saw Y; that caused Z. Try A next time."
```
Priya K: perfect. I'll pilot in my team's 1:1 template.
Ezra M: small nit: add a short "stretch" line optional for growth goals.
Sana (People Ops): will add optional stretch line before final publish. thanks everyone.
CoachBot: Tip: pre-fill this in the calendar notes 24h before the 1:1 to make the meeting focused and save time.
